name: Buy the tools and metal for Fenkenstrain

evidence.note: Estimated purchase budget for the listed supplies.

name: Accept Fenkenstrain’s assignment

evidence.note: Speak to Fenkenstrain in his castle.

name: Find the amulet pieces in the castle bookcases

evidence.note: Search both upstairs bookcases and combine the amulet pieces.

name: Ask the Gardener Ghost to help find his head

evidence.note: Wear the Ghostspeak amulet, follow the gardener to the Haunted Woods and dig at Lestwit’s grave.

name: Buy the pickled brain in Canifis

evidence.note: Ask Roavar for food and pay 50 coins for the pickled brain.

name: Open the memorial and descend

evidence.note: Use the star amulet to open the memorial.

name: Defeat the Experiment and recover the body parts

evidence.note: Kill the experiment for its key. Leave the cave via the northwest ladder and dig up three body parts on the burial island.

planned_outcome.success_condition: The torso, arms and legs have been recovered.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Defeat the level 51 Experiment, collect its key and search all three graves.

name: Give Fenkenstrain the assembled head and body parts

evidence.note: Fit the brain into the head and give the doctor the parts, needle and thread.

name: Make an extended brush and find the conductor mould

evidence.note: Ask for the shed key, take the brush and three canes, bind them with bronze wire and use the brush on the upstairs fireplace.

name: Cast a lightning conductor

evidence.note: Use the conductor mould and a silver bar at the furnace.

name: Install the conductor on the roof

evidence.note: Replace the damaged conductor and speak to Fenkenstrain for the tower key.

name: Listen to the creature in the tower

evidence.note: Use the key and speak to the creature to learn what happened.

name: Pickpocket the Ring of charos from Fenkenstrain

evidence.note: Pickpocket the doctor to receive the Ring of charos, 1,000 Thieving XP and two quest points.

name: Buy garden tools and filled watering can

evidence.note: Estimated purchase budget for the listed supplies.

name: Buy seeds, cures, compost and a filled plant pot

evidence.note: Estimated purchase budget for the listed supplies.

name: Accept Ellamaria’s garden request

evidence.note: Ask Ellamaria about the garden.

name: Answer the Wise Old Man’s questions

evidence.note: Answer the questions to activate the Ring of charos.

name: Plant marigolds

evidence.note: Clear the patch, talk to the gardener with the activated ring, plant and water the crop.

planned_outcome.success_condition: A quest crop has been planted.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Carry extra seeds and use the available patches if the crop fails.

name: Show the gardener the grown marigolds

evidence.note: Harvest a grown marigold and give it to Elstan for delphinium seeds.

planned_outcome.success_condition: The gardener supplies the quest seeds.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Cure or replant a failed crop and return once it has grown.

name: Plant onions

evidence.note: Clear the patch, talk to the gardener with the activated ring, plant and water the crop.

planned_outcome.success_condition: A quest crop has been planted.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Carry extra seeds and use the available patches if the crop fails.

name: Show the gardener the grown onions

evidence.note: Show Lyra her fully grown onions for the two colors of orchid seeds.

planned_outcome.success_condition: The gardener supplies the quest seeds.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Cure or replant a failed crop and return once it has grown.

name: Plant cabbages

evidence.note: Clear the patch, talk to the gardener with the activated ring, plant and water the crop.

planned_outcome.success_condition: A quest crop has been planted.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Carry extra seeds and use the available patches if the crop fails.

name: Show the gardener the grown cabbages

evidence.note: Show Kragen his fully grown cabbages for snowdrop seeds.

planned_outcome.success_condition: The gardener supplies the quest seeds.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Cure or replant a failed crop and return once it has grown.

name: Ask Dantaera how to save the white tree

evidence.note: Ask Dantaera about the tree with the activated ring.

name: Take, pot and water the white tree cutting

evidence.note: Take the cutting with secateurs, put it in the filled pot and water it.

name: Ask Brother Althric about the roses

evidence.note: Learn how to obtain his rose seeds.

name: Put the activated ring in the Edgeville well

evidence.note: Put the ring in the well so you can return to the monastery without it.

name: Collect the three colours of rose seed

evidence.note: Get permission and collect the rose seeds.

name: Fish the Ring of charos out of the well

evidence.note: Use a fishing rod to recover the ring.

name: Try ordinary plant cure on Bernald’s vines

evidence.note: Ask Bernald and try the ordinary cure.

name: Ask Alain how to improve plant cure

evidence.note: Unequip the ring before speaking to Alain.

name: Cure the vines and ask for seeds

evidence.note: Break and grind essence, strengthen the second cure and use it on the vines. Equip the ring to ask for seeds.

name: Plant the grown white tree sapling

evidence.note: Use the watered cutting once it has become a sapling.

name: Plant the delphiniums

evidence.note: Plant Elstan’s seeds in the palace garden.

name: Compost both pots and plant the orchids

evidence.note: Use compost in the pots and plant both colours of orchid.

name: Plant the snowdrops

evidence.note: Plant Kragen’s seeds in the palace garden.

name: Plant the three colours of roses

evidence.note: Plant the three rose patches.

name: Plant the vine

evidence.note: Plant Bernald’s seeds in the garden.

name: Ask Ellamaria for the trolley

evidence.note: Borrow the trolley to move both statues.

name: Move the Lumbridge statue into the garden

evidence.note: Use the trolley and follow the quest statue transport route to the marked palace plinth.

name: Move the Falador statue into the garden

evidence.note: Use the trolley and follow the quest statue transport route to the marked palace plinth.

name: Tell Ellamaria the garden is ready

evidence.note: Wait until every planted garden patch is ready and both statues are in place.

name: Invite King Roald to visit the garden

evidence.note: Wear the activated ring and lead King Roald to the garden.

name: Finish the conversation with Ellamaria

evidence.note: Receive two quest points, 5,000 Farming XP, a four-dose supercompost potion, an apple tree seed, an acorn and five guam seeds. First fruit grows on a separate post-quest timer.

name: Pick a white tree fruit

evidence.note: Pick a grown fruit in Ellamaria’s garden to satisfy the Varrock Medium task.

name: Buy Ghosts Ahoy supplies

evidence.note: Estimated purchase budget for the listed supplies.

name: Buy bones for the Ectofuntus

evidence.note: Estimated purchase budget for the listed supplies.

name: Worship at the Ectofuntus

evidence.note: Grind four normal bones, gather slime, worship, and collect the tokens. Reuse the bucket and pot one bone at a time. Normal bones give 18 Prayer XP each. Speak to the ghost disciple after each set to collect the tokens.

name: Worship at the Ectofuntus

evidence.note: Grind four normal bones, gather slime, worship, and collect the tokens. Reuse the bucket and pot one bone at a time. Normal bones give 18 Prayer XP each. Speak to the ghost disciple after each set to collect the tokens.

name: Worship at the Ectofuntus

evidence.note: Grind four normal bones, gather slime, worship, and collect the tokens. Reuse the bucket and pot one bone at a time. Normal bones give 18 Prayer XP each. Speak to the ghost disciple after each set to collect the tokens.

name: Make nettle tea

evidence.note: Pick nettles near Draynor jail while wearing gloves. Add them to a bowl of water and heat the mixture on a lit log. Incidental XP remains in review.

name: Fill a bucket with ectoplasm

evidence.note: Descend to the slime pool under the Ectofuntus and return with the bucket.

name: Hear Velorina's request

evidence.note: Wear a Ghostspeak amulet to start.

name: Ask Necrovarus to release the ghosts

evidence.note: The disciple's master refuses.

name: Return to Velorina

evidence.note: Learn that the Old Crone can help.

name: Serve the Old Crone nettle tea

evidence.note: Pour the tea into her cup and add milk. Offer to repair the model ship.

name: Repair the Old Crone's ship and match the rigging

evidence.note: Sew the sail and inspect the shipwreck's flags. The three colors are randomized. The supply bundle reserves three of each color.

name: Return the repaired ship for a map scrap

evidence.note: Show the correctly colored model to the Old Crone.

name: Defeat the giant lobster and open the captain's chest

evidence.note: Search the hold chest, defeat the level 32 lobster, and unlock the captain's chest upstairs.

planned_outcome.success_condition: The giant lobster is defeated and the map scrap recovered.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Budget additional time and supplies for the fight if needed.

name: Cross the gangplank and find the third scrap

evidence.note: Cross the gangplank and jump the rocks north of the shipwreck.

name: Assemble the treasure map

evidence.note: Combine the three scraps.

name: Dig for the Book of haricanto

evidence.note: Dig at the marked spot on Dragontooth Island.

name: Trade Robin's autograph for the translation manual

evidence.note: Talk to Ak-Haranu, win four rounds of Rune Draw with Robin, and exchange the signed oak longbow. The coin cost budgets the game.

name: Get and disguise the bedsheet

evidence.note: Get the bedsheet from the innkeeper and dye it with ectoplasm.

name: Collect ten signatures for Gravingas

evidence.note: Wear the disguised bedsheet and collect signatures. The budget includes a paid signature if needed.

name: Present the petition and take the mystical robes

evidence.note: Pick up the key Necrovarus drops, then climb upstairs and open the locked room.

name: Have the Old Crone enchant the Ghostspeak amulet

evidence.note: Give the Crone the book, manual and robes. Treat the temporary enchantment as quest progress.

name: Compel Necrovarus to release the ghosts

evidence.note: Equip the enchanted amulet and order Necrovarus to free the ghosts.

name: Tell Velorina the ghosts are free

evidence.note: Awards two quest points, 2,400 Prayer XP and a refillable Ectophial. Subsequent gate entries are free.

name: Buy Animal Magnetism supplies

evidence.note: Estimated purchase budget for the listed supplies.

name: Ask Ava about her bed

evidence.note: Start with The Restless Ghost, Ernest the Chicken and Priest in Peril complete. All four skill gates are unboostable.

name: Talk to Alice and her husband

evidence.note: Pass messages between Alice and her husband until they request a translation amulet.

name: Ask the Old Crone for a crone-made amulet

evidence.note: The Old Crone makes a second amulet. Keep the original Ghostspeak amulet.

name: Give the amulet and buy two undead chickens

evidence.note: Give the husband the crone-made amulet and buy two undead chickens for 10 ecto-tokens each.

name: Give Ava the undead chickens

evidence.note: Ava asks for a magnet.

name: Give five iron bars to the witch

evidence.note: The witch hands over a selected iron bar.

name: Hammer the selected iron while facing north

evidence.note: Use a hammer on the iron in the Rimmington mine while facing north.

name: Deliver the magnet and attempt to chop an undead tree

evidence.note: Give Ava the magnet, try an undead tree outside with a normal axe, and ask Ava how to cut it.

name: Exchange the mithril axe and holy symbol with Turael

evidence.note: Trade the two items for the blessed axe.

name: Cut undead twigs and give them to Ava

evidence.note: Use the blessed axe to cut an undead tree in the manor grounds and bring the twigs to Ava.

name: Translate Ava's notes

evidence.note: Solve the notes puzzle, return the translation, and receive the pattern.

name: Make Ava's container

evidence.note: Use the pattern with hard leather and polished buttons.

name: Give the container to Ava

evidence.note: Awards one quest point, 1,000 Crafting, Fletching and Slayer XP, and 2,500 Woodcutting XP. Ava gives an attractor below 50 Ranged or an accumulator at 50 Ranged or above. The inventory entry represents the device at either tier.

name: Buy Shades of Mort'ton supplies

evidence.note: Estimated purchase budget for the listed supplies.

name: Find and read Herbi Flax's diary

evidence.note: Search the shelf in the ruined house to learn the Serum 207 recipe.

name: Mix two vials of Serum 207

evidence.note: Combine two unfinished tarromin potions with two ashes. Record the potion as six doses and the two mixing awards.

name: Temporarily cure Razmire

evidence.note: Use one dose of Serum 207 to learn what the town needs.

name: Defeat five Loar shades and collect the remains

evidence.note: Kill five Loar shades and collect their remains.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Five shades are defeated and their remains collected.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Allow additional combat time and bring food as needed.

name: Return to Razmire and buy temple supplies

evidence.note: Use another dose and ask about the remains. Buy timber beams, limestone bricks, swamp paste and olive oil from his stores.

name: Cure Ulsquire and discuss the remains

evidence.note: Show Ulsquire the remains, then ask how to lay a shade to rest.

name: Repair the temple and make sacred oil

evidence.note: Repair the temple to 100% and gain at least 10% sanctity. Light the central flame and bless the olive oil. The materials reserve is sized for a group repair.

planned_outcome.success_condition: The temple flame is burning and the olive oil has been blessed.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Repair or defend the temple longer if other players are unavailable.

name: Lay a Loar shade to rest

evidence.note: Oil the logs, then use the pyre logs, remains and tinderbox on a funeral pyre. Random pyre loot is outside this step's effects.

name: Report the cremation to Ulsquire

evidence.note: Awards three quest points, 2,000 Crafting and 2,000 Herblore XP. The permanent cure can be prepared separately.

name: Make Serum 208

evidence.note: Reach 20% sanctity and bless a vial with at least two doses. Reserve building materials for this separate visit.

planned_outcome.success_condition: The temple is repaired and the serum is blessed.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Allow extra time for repairs if the temple is damaged.

name: Buy extra temple repair supplies

evidence.note: Trade with Razmire when temporarily or permanently cured. Budget includes a temporary cure on this purchase route.

name: Cure Razmire permanently

evidence.note: Use Serum 208 on Razmire to unlock permanent access to his stores.

name: Make another vial of Serum 207

evidence.note: Combine ashes with an unfinished tarromin potion for three more doses.

name: Buy a second batch of serum ingredients

evidence.note: Estimated purchase budget for the listed supplies.

name: Speak to the Zealot and pickpocket his key

evidence.note: Ask the Zealot about the mine, then take his key when he refuses entry.

name: Set the cart points and send a glowing fungus

evidence.note: Read the panel, set the levers to reach the northwestern collection cart, pick a glowing fungus and place it in the cart. Return to the surface for the northern entrance.

name: Recover the glowing fungus from the cart

evidence.note: Collect the fungus from the northwestern cart. Keep it underground and use dry paths.

name: Unlock the lift and descend to the boss

evidence.note: Use the Zealot's key on the valve, turn it and immediately run to the lift before it is closed. Pick up the nearby chisel before descending.

name: Defeat Treus Dayth and pick up the crystal-mine key

evidence.note: Attempt to pick up the key to start the fight. Avoid the moving equipment and defeat Treus Dayth.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Treus Dayth is defeated and the crystal-mine key recovered.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Bring food and budget additional time for the moving machinery and boss.

name: Cut a salve shard from the crystal outcrop

evidence.note: Open the crystal chamber and cut the first salve shard. Awards two quest points and 22,000 Strength XP.

name: String a Salve amulet

evidence.note: Attach a ball of wool to the shard. This is a separate craft after the quest.

name: Defeat Tarn Razorlor and his ghost

evidence.note: Fight both forms of Tarn and advance through the passage north of the arena.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Both forms of Tarn have been defeated.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Bring food and budget additional time for the fight.

name: Collect Tarn's diary

evidence.note: Collect the diary to earn 5,000 Slayer XP and unlock Salve amulet enchantment.

name: Enchant a Salve amulet

evidence.note: Use Tarn's diary on the amulet. Keep the diary.

name: Buy Tears of Guthix supplies

evidence.note: Estimated purchase budget for the listed supplies.

name: Fill and light a sapphire lantern

evidence.note: Swap the lens for a sapphire, fuel the lantern using swamp tar at the chemist's still, then light it.

name: Attach a rope to the swamp cave entrance

evidence.note: Attach a rope to the dark hole for repeat access.

name: Tell Juna a story about your adventures

evidence.note: Juna requires at least 43 quest points and asks for a stone bowl.

name: Use the sapphire lantern on a light creature

evidence.note: Attract a light creature to cross the chasm.

name: Mine the magic stone and carve a bowl

evidence.note: Mine the special stone and use a chisel to make the bowl.

name: Give the stone bowl to Juna

evidence.note: Awards one quest point, 1,000 Crafting XP and access to the Tears of Guthix activity. Weekly XP claims remain in review.
